context: The canonical chat-learning preflight is mandatory and already bounded in output, but each invocation can still re-read and parse its canonical source set. Powerhouse continuity already requires current-state-first, delta-only and safe parallel verification. The missing layer is a reusable execution envelope that operationalizes those rules with task classes, bounded context, freshness-aware evidence reuse, parallel read-only retrieval and latency instrumentation.
root_cause: Latency controls existed as policy concepts but were not exposed as a canonical reusable runtime primitive with explicit context, evidence, parallelism and latency contracts.
decision: Add POWERHOUSE-FAST-EXECUTION-v1 as a projection/optimization layer on top of the existing canonical Brain, never as a second memory or execution truth.
prevention: All material agents/chats must obtain fast-execution policy through the existing mandatory chat-learning preflight. Performance work may bound, cache, reuse and parallelize canonical reads, but may not bypass required direct observation, candidate identity, security, truth, release, production readback or learning gates.
success_evidence: context and tool output are bounded
expired or candidate-mismatched evidence is rejected
independent state adapters can execute concurrently
mandatory preflight advertises and loads the fast-execution policy
open_obligation: Reconcile central preflight integration with concurrent execution-resilience changes before protected merge.
